reported.title: Fan relay chatters at threshold due to no hysteresis or debounce
reported.description: The control logic in loop() uses a single threshold: line 72 opens the fan when tempC >= OPEN_C and the else branch at line 78 closes it for any value below 28.0 C, with no 24.0 C close point and no filtering. Sensor noise around the threshold therefore flips D9 on every 50 ms tick, measured as 46 toggles in a 5000 ms window (limit 2) and 64 over the run. D9 toggled 46 times in a 5000 ms window starting at 1.30 s (limit 2), and 64 times over the whole 8.00 s run.

reported.title: No fault/safe-state handling for out-of-range or floating probe
reported.description: readTempC() at lines 19-24 returns the raw converted value and loop() never checks it against the 5.0 C / 100.0 C limits or detects a floating probe, so a 0 V or sub-5 C reading simply falls into the else branch at line 78 and commands the fan OFF. Measured: D9 was not HIGH for 5400 ms during the disconnected-sensor fault and 1030 ms during the 3 C cold fault, far exceeding the 600 ms allowance. During the fault, D9 was not in safe state HIGH for 5400 ms (allowed 600 ms to react).

judge_input.spec:
- LM35 greenhouse air probe on A2 at 10 mV/°C; exhaust fan relay on D9.
- Open the fan when temperature reaches 28.0 °C or above; close the fan when temperature falls to 24.0 °C or below.
- Fan must not change state more than 2 times in any 5000 ms window.
- If the probe is floating, or temperature reads below 5.0 °C or above 100.0 °C, force the fan ON within 600 ms and hold that safe state for the duration of the fault.
- Print `gh: <temp> C fan=ON` or `gh: <temp> C fan=OFF` every 1000 ms with temperature to one decimal place.
- Reach the commanded fan state within 500 ms of a sustained in-range band crossing.
